messages:
Alex: claiming the evening deploy slot 21:00-21:30 PT for kernel v2.4 + quant-profile 'q-lite-2'. planning a small staggered rollout across 3 slices. can anyone take rollback ownership?
Priya: I can own rollback and the post-deploy validation checklist. will be online during the window.
Sam: please ping me 10m before we start — I'll hotfix any broken CI/gating issues and merge the final canary config. link to CR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/merge/3482
Lucy: quick q — does q-lite-2 change KV cache layout or just op quant params? affects warmup script.
Alex: q-lite-2 changes op quant params only, no KV layout changes. warmup still same but we should run the short prime set.
Irene: smoke tests I want: 1) 5 concurrent chat sessions 2) embeddings latency sanity 3) KV cache hit-rate snapshot 4) roll-forward token counts. I'll push a small test harness.
Mike: I'll be oncall for infra during the window. Marcus & team notified. set me as escalation if anything hits >10% error rate.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy window reserved by @Alex for 2026-03-17T21:00:00-07:00 (30m). canary slices: s1,s2,s3.
Alex: ops checklist (short):
- preflight: confirm canary AMI + image digest (sha256:abcd1234)
- 2x smoke workers ready in each target slice
- run warmup: `scripts/warmup.sh --profile q-lite-2 --samples 20`
- monitor: /dash/model-latency, /dash/error-rate, traces for decode spikes
- rollback cmd: `kubectl set image deploy/runtime runtime=redwood/runtime:v2.3.9 && kubectl rollout status deploy/runtime`
Priya: added my validation steps to the shared doc. will post a condensed runbook 15m before.
Sam: small note — toggling the kernel flag `--prefetch=true` during canary, don't change in the middle of a slice unless we see perf regression.
Lucy: thanks, adding a quick prompt set for quality checks (10 prompts, edge cases). will run against canary and baseline.
Irene: can someone drop the tracing span name we'll watch? using `runtime.kernel.exec` and `runtime.decode.token` as primary spans.
Alex: logging that. final ask: @Sam @Mike please confirm you're both good to receive alerts. if no objections by 20:40 PT I'll proceed with the schedule. :thumbsup:
Sam: 👍 good for me.
Mike: 👍 I'll have escalation channel open.
Priya: all set from qa side.
Alex: thanks all — I'll post the start signal in this thread and tag deploy-bot when kicking off.
